mapper.select: SELECT session_id, account_id, profile_user_id, entry_scene, active_preferences_json, last_user_query, started_at, last_active_at, status FROM rs_user_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE rs_user_session SET status = 'ENDED', end_reason = #{reason}, ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_active_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
